name: gray ooze
desc: Gray Ooze is a CR 0.5 ooze.

actions.name: corrode metal
actions.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed after dealing damage. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.fqbFYtbtkrL53FOC.Item.uSay5J2sf9zXsabi.ActiveEffect.Khdj386syEL9V9OA]{Corroded Weapon} enchantment to a weapon, granting it a cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls each time the enchantment is applied.

actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

actions.name: pseudopod
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.fqbFYtbtkrL53FOC.Item.KO4qRywgiEQ3F004.ActiveEffect.SiRqKDm2qerReaj8]{Corroded Armor} enchantment to a suit of armor, granting it a cumulative -1 to the AC it offers each time the enchantment is applied.

actions.name: amorphous
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}.
